Cluster: Contribution lifecycle, reversals and collection. Proposed integrated rule: Track acceptance, receipt, availability, valuation, allocation, acknowledgment and finality separately by asset/rail. Reversible ACH may be provisionally credited only under OD-04; a later return creates a receivable/exposure and collection policy, not silent negative charitable balance. Acknowledgment wording and timing require tax counsel and primary Nacha text. Challenge: no universally safe 60-day rule or automatic acknowledgment; return windows vary by reason, account type and governing rules. Evidence remains pending; no validation executed.
